mathematics.assertion_tested: At k=0.3,3,30 on the existing fixed-action sourced background for 0<=t<=0.02, equal initial quadratic gradient variances permit opposite derivatives; states with zero initial derivative have nonzero second derivative. Independently evolve the six-state fundamental matrix and three covariance ensembles, compare transport, original Euler residuals, PSD, and time-step/tolerance refinement.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64, SymPy exact-symbolic source-derived action coefficients, numerical ODE and finite-difference checks conditional on stated tolerances
mathematics.conventions: Physical proper time, delta tau=0 and e=0 gauge. u contains RMS real Fourier/quadrature amplitudes, C=<u u^T>, Y2=k^2/a^2*C00. Source cosine amplitudes instead give Y2=k^2/a^2*sigma_amp^2/2. All six source-state components and time-varying coefficient rates retained. No coefficients reconstructed or retuned.
inputs: Existing frozen-action Background(.02), three finite k values, three zero-mean rank-one initial ensembles with sigma_RMS=1e-6/k and sigma_dot=(H+d)*sigma for d=-1,0,+1
non_claims: No nonlinear, all-k, global or late-time attractor exclusion
No radiation-era, primordial-spectrum, CMB or observed cosmology prediction
No use of a phenomenological scalar growth law
No extrapolation to finite nonlinear variance; perturbation scaling is explicit
k=0 projected-gradient observable vanishes identically; the finite-k reduction is not applied there
No interval-certified numerical accuracy or independent proof of every source equation
